label: Correct autofluorescence (per cell)
purpose: Remove each cell's autofluorescence from its marker intensities, per fluorophore
useWhen: Cyclic panels (PhenoCycler, IBEX, CODEX): markers on one dye rise together
Before gating or clustering dim markers such as CD3, CD4, CD8 or CD20
notWhen: Fewer than 3 markers per dye: nothing to estimate the background from
Image-level autofluorescence: use AF correction on the image instead

params.label: Label set
params.tip: Cell table to correct; adds af_<channel> beside each measured channel

params.label: Markers per cycle
params.tip: Markers imaged per cycle, not counting nuclear stains

params.label: Nuclear stains
params.tip: Stains outside the marker cycle; empty finds DAPI, Hoechst, DNA_n by name

params.label: Leave as measured
params.tip: Markers not to correct, e.g. a failed stain
